title: Cache: what expires, what is pinned, and how large it may grow

videos.script:
Most of what an app stores is called a cache, and most of it is not one. {{kinds}} A session the person typed offline is the only copy there is. Notes they pinned for a flight are a promise. Only a copy the server still has is a cache.

That third kind follows three rules today. {{expiry}} First, how long a copy may be shown before it is checked. The server says so with max-age, and an ETag makes the check cost almost nothing.

{{budget}} Second, how large the cache may grow. You give it a budget in bytes, and the picture nobody has looked at for longest leaves first.

{{cleared}} Third, what happens when the system empties the folder without asking. It will. You delete it yourself, run the planner, and watch it carry on as if nothing happened. That is the test of a cache that was built right.
